proposed_rules.trigger: A pricing page body containing a plan-name header row ([Nx1]) followed by expandable feature-category rows ('+'/'−' toggles), each expanding to per-feature comparison rows across the same N plan columns.
proposed_rules.decision: Emit ONE 'pricing-table' block: header row = plan names, one row per feature category, one sub-row per feature when expanded. Rejected alternatives: (a) treat each category as its own accordion block (loses the shared plan-column structure), (b) flatten into plain markdown table (loses expand/collapse authoring).
proposed_rules.rationale: This is a distinct, site-specific interactive comparison-table pattern not covered by repeating-cards-are-one-block (not uniform cards) nor faq-accordion-block (not Q&A).

provenance.evidence: C165 rc1c2c4 header row + 11 core-capability rows + 10 collapsible category rows

proposed_rules.trigger: A '2x1' zone with 'The best no-code platform for...' CTA text plus a '| |' separator at the bottom of every page.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as the site-wide footer fragment, excluded from per-page block inventory.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical across every captured page = global chrome, analogous to knack-announcement-bar. Rejected: per-page footer block.

proposed_rules.trigger: An FAQ [region] answer appears as a sibling of an unrelated heading instead of nested under its own question row.
proposed_rules.decision: Fold back into the accordion block as the answer for its corresponding question.
proposed_rules.rationale: Artifact of overlay-promotion logic in the capture pipeline, not real content structure.

provenance.evidence: C165 rc1c2c5c3 'You own it!...' next to 'What Makes Knack Different?' heading
